title: Spark 4.0.1 MongoDB Connector 10.5.0: Missing configuration for: collection and NoClassDefFoundError: com.mongodb.client.MongoClient
question:
I am trying to read data from MongoDB in Spark 4.0.1 using the MongoDB Spark Connector (version 10.5.0). My PySpark code looks like this:

from pyspark.sql import SparkSession

spark = SparkSession.builder \
    .appName("MongoTest") \    
    .getOrCreate()

reader = (
    spark.read.format("mongodb")
    .option("spark.mongodb.connection.uri", uri)
    .option("database", database)
    .option("collection", collection)
)

df = reader.load()
df.show()

My MongoDB URI is:

mongodb://it:pass@127.0.0.1:27017/authSource=myit&directConnection=true

Despite specifying the collection and database, I am encountering two errors:

  1. Missing configuration for: collection
  2. NoClassDefFoundError: com.mongodb.client.MongoClient

I am using the following JAR files in my Spark session:

  • mongo-spark-connector_2.13-10.5.0.jar
  • mongodb-driver-core-5.6.1.jar
  • bson-5.6.1.jar

I have tried different variations of the .option() keys, including spark.mongodb.input.uri, spark.mongodb.input.database, and spark.mongodb.input.collection, but the errors persist.

Has anyone encountered this issue with Spark 4 and the latest MongoDB connector? How can I properly configure the connector to load the collection without running into these errors?
answer:
by using this jar files with pyspark 4.0.1 solved my problem :

        "mongo-spark-connector_2.13-10.5.0.jar"
       "bson-5.1.1.jar",
       "mongodb-driver-core-5.1.1.jar",
       "mongodb-driver-sync-5.1.1.jar",

also this code:
    df = (
            spark.read.format("mongodb")
            .option("spark.mongodb.read.connection.uri", uri) 
            .option("database", database)                  
            .option("collection", collection)                  
            .load()
        )
